parameters.jsCode:
const { exec, execSync } = require('child_process');
const fs = require('fs');
const path = require('path');

const imgData = $input.first().json;
const images = imgData.imageBase64Array || [];
if (images.length === 0) throw new Error('No images found from Generate Images');

const tmpDir = '/tmp/n8n_hunyuan_' + Date.now();
fs.mkdirSync(tmpDir, { recursive: true });

try {
  const workflow = {
    '1': { class_type: 'UnetLoaderGGUF', inputs: { unet_name: 'hunyuan-video-i2v-720p-Q4_K_M.gguf' } },
    '2': { class_type: 'DualCLIPLoader', inputs: { clip_name1: 'split_files\\text_encoder\\llava_llama3_fp8_scaled.safetensors', clip_name2: 'clip_l.safetensors', type: 'hunyuan_video' } },
    '3': { class_type: 'CLIPVisionLoader', inputs: { clip_name: 'split_files\\clip_vision\\llava_llama3_vision.safetensors' } },
    '4': { class_type: 'VAELoader', inputs: { vae_name: 'split_files\\vae\\hunyuan_video_vae_bf16.safetensors' } },
    '5': { class_type: 'LoadImage', inputs: { image: 'PLACEHOLDER' } },
    '6': { class_type: 'CLIPVisionEncode', inputs: { clip_vision: ['3', 0], image: ['5', 0], crop: 'center' } },
    '7': { class_type: 'TextEncodeHunyuanVideo_ImageToVideo', inputs: { prompt: 'PLACEHOLDER', clip: ['2', 0], clip_vision_output: ['6', 0], image_interleave: 2 } },
    '8': { class_type: 'HunyuanImageToVideo', inputs: { positive: ['7', 0], vae: ['4', 0], width: 544, height: 960, length: 49, batch_size: 1, guidance_type: 'v2 (replace)', start_image: ['5', 0] } },
    '9': { class_type: 'CLIPTextEncode', inputs: { text: '', clip: ['2', 0] } },
    '10': { class_type: 'KSampler', inputs: { model: ['1', 0], positive: ['8', 0], negative: ['9', 0], latent_image: ['8', 1], seed: 0, steps: 20, cfg: 1.0, sampler_name: 'euler', scheduler: 'normal', denoise: 1.0 } },
    '11': { class_type: 'VAEDecodeTiled', inputs: { samples: ['10', 0], vae: ['4', 0], tile_size: 128, overlap: 32, temporal_size: 32, temporal_overlap: 4 } },
    '12': { class_type: 'SaveImage', inputs: { filename_prefix: 'hunyuan_n8n', images: ['11', 0] } }
  };

  const motions = [
    'slow cinematic zoom in, subtle atmospheric movement',
    'gentle camera pan from left to right, slight depth-of-field shift',
    'smooth dolly forward motion, ambient particle effects',
    'slow dramatic zoom out revealing the full scene, subtle lighting changes',
    'camera slowly orbiting around the subject, atmospheric haze',
    'gentle upward tilt, light rays subtly shifting',
    'smooth lateral tracking shot, foreground and background parallax',
    'slow push in with soft focus transition, cinematic lighting'
  ];

  const imagePrompts = imgData.imagePrompts || [];
  const motionPrompts = images.map((_, i) => {
    const motion = motions[i % motions.length];
    const origPrompt = imagePrompts[i] || '';
    return motion + '. ' + origPrompt;
  });

  const config = { images, workflow, motionPrompts };
  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmpDir, 'config.json'), JSON.stringify(config));

  const script = [
    "const http = require('http');",
    "const fs = require('fs');",
    "const path = require('path');",
    "const { execSync } = require('child_process');",
    "const tmpDir = process.argv[2];",
    "const config = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(path.join(tmpDir, 'config.json'), 'utf8'));",
    "const images = config.images;",
    "const WORKFLOW = config.workflow;",
    "const motionPrompts = config.motionPrompts;",
    "const COMFYUI = 'http://host.docker.internal:8188';",
    "const GLOBAL_BUDGET_MS = 9000000;",
    "const START = Date.now();",
    "const sleep = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));",
    "function timeLeft() { return GLOBAL_BUDGET_MS - (Date.now() - START); }",
    "",
    "function httpReq(urlStr, opts) {",
    "  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {",
    "    const u = new URL(urlStr);",
    "    const method = (opts&&opts.method)||'GET';",
    "    const headers = (opts&&opts.headers)||{};",
    "    const body = opts&&opts.body;",
    "    const tout = (opts&&opts.timeout)||120000;",
    "    const r = http.request({hostname:u.hostname,port:u.port||8188,path:u.pathname+u.search,method,headers}, res => {",
    "      const chunks=[];",
    "      res.on('data',c=>chunks.push(c));",
    "      res.on('end',()=>resolve({status:res.statusCode,headers:res.headers,body:Buffer.concat(chunks)}));",
    "    });",
    "    r.on('error',reject);",
    "    r.setTimeout(tout,()=>{r.destroy();reject(new Error('Timeout'));});",
    "    if(body)r.write(body);",
    "    r.end();",
    "  });",
    "}",
    "",
    "async function uploadImage(imgPath, filename) {",
    "  const fileData = fs.readFileSync(imgPath);",
    "  const boundary = '----n8nboundary' + Date.now();",
    "  const bodyStart = Buffer.from('--' + boundary + '\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"image\"; filename=\"' + filename + '\"\\r\\nContent-Type: image/png\\r\\n\\r\\n');",
    "  const bodyEnd = Buffer.from('\\r\\n--' + boundary + '\\r\\nContent-Disposition: form-data; name=\"overwrite\"\\r\\n\\r\\ntrue\\r\\n--' + boundary + '--\\r\\n');",
    "  const fullBody = Buffer.concat([bodyStart, fileData, bodyEnd]);",
    "  const res = await httpReq(COMFYUI + '/upload/image', {",
    "    method: 'POST',",
    "    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'multipart/form-data; boundary=' + boundary, 'Content-Length': fullBody.length },",
    "    body: fullBody, timeout: 30000",
    "  });",
    "  if (res.status !== 200) throw new Error('Upload failed: HTTP ' + res.status);",
    "  return JSON.parse(res.body.toString()).name;",
    "}",
    "",
    "async function submitPrompt(wf, clientId) {",
    "  const payload = JSON.stringify({ prompt: wf, client_id: clientId });",
    "  const res = await httpReq(COMFYUI + '/prompt', { method: 'POST', body: payload, headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });",
    "  if (res.status !== 200) throw new Error('Submit failed: HTTP ' + res.status + ' ' + res.body.toString().substring(0, 200));",
    "  return JSON.parse(res.body.toString()).prompt_id;",
    "}",
    "",
    "async function pollHistory(promptId, timeoutMs) {",
    "  const start = Date.now();",
    "  while (Date.now() - start < timeoutMs) {",
    "    try {",
    "      const res = await httpReq(COMFYUI + '/history/' + promptId, { timeout: 10000 });",
    "      if (res.status === 200) {",
    "        const data = JSON.parse(res.body.toString());",
    "        if (data[promptId] && data[promptId].status) {",
    "          if (data[promptId].status.status_str === 'error') {",
    "            const err = data[promptId].status.messages.find(m => m[0] === 'execution_error');",
    "            throw new Error('ComfyUI error: ' + (err ? JSON.stringify(err[1]).substring(0, 300) : 'unknown'));",
    "          }",
    "          if (data[promptId].outputs && Object.keys(data[promptId].outputs).length > 0) return data[promptId];",
    "        }",
    "      }",
    "    } catch(e) { if (e.message.startsWith('ComfyUI error')) throw e; }",
    "    await sleep(5000);",
    "  }",
    "  throw new Error('ComfyUI timeout after ' + (timeoutMs/1000) + 's');",
    "}",
    "",
    "async function downloadFile(filename, subfolder, type) {",
    "  const url = COMFYUI + '/view?filename=' + encodeURIComponent(filename) + '&subfolder=' + encodeURIComponent(subfolder||'') + '&type=' + encodeURIComponent(type||'output');",
    "  const res = await httpReq(url, { timeout: 60000 });",
    "  if (res.status !== 200) throw new Error('Download failed: HTTP ' + res.status);",
    "  return res.body;",
    "}",
    "",
    "function makeStaticClip(imgPath, outPath, duration) {",
    "  execSync('ffmpeg -y -loop 1 -t ' + duration + ' -i \"' + imgPath + '\" -c:v libx264 -preset fast -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p -vf scale=544:960:force_original_aspect_ratio=increase,crop=544:960 \"' + outPath + '\"', { timeout: 30000 });",
    "}",
    "",
    "async function animateImage(imgBase64, motionPrompt, idx) {",
    "  const imgPath = path.join(tmpDir, 'img_' + idx + '.png');",
    "  fs.writeFileSync(imgPath, Buffer.from(imgBase64, 'base64'));",
    "",
    "  const remaining = images.length - idx;",
    "  const perClipBudget = timeLeft() / remaining;",
    "  if (perClipBudget < 120000) {",
    "    process.stderr.write('  Budget low, using static clip\\n');",
    "    const mp4Path = path.join(tmpDir, 'clip_' + idx + '.mp4');",
    "    makeStaticClip(imgPath, mp4Path, 3);",
    "    return { clip: fs.readFileSync(mp4Path).toString('base64'), duration: 3.0 };",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  const uploadedName = await uploadImage(imgPath, 'n8n_img_' + idx + '.png');",
    "  process.stderr.write('  Uploaded as: ' + uploadedName + '\\n');",
    "",
    "  const wf = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(WORKFLOW));",
    "  wf['5'].inputs.image = uploadedName;",
    "  wf['7'].inputs.prompt = motionPrompt;",
    "  wf['10'].inputs.seed = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2147483647);",
    "",
    "  const clientId = 'n8n-hunyuan-' + Date.now() + '-' + idx;",
    "  const promptId = await submitPrompt(wf, clientId);",
    "  process.stderr.write('  Submitted ' + promptId.substring(0, 8) + '...\\n');",
    "  const result = await pollHistory(promptId, 1800000);",
    "",
    "  const frames = (result.outputs['12'] || {}).images || [];",
    "  if (frames.length === 0) throw new Error('No output frames from SaveImage node 12');",
    "  process.stderr.write('  Downloading ' + frames.length + ' frames...\\n');",
    "",
    "  const framesDir = path.join(tmpDir, 'frames_' + idx);",
    "  fs.mkdirSync(framesDir, { recursive: true });",
    "  for (let fi = 0; fi < frames.length; fi++) {",
    "    const fInfo = frames[fi];",
    "    const fBuf = await downloadFile(fInfo.filename, fInfo.subfolder, fInfo.type);",
    "    fs.writeFileSync(path.join(framesDir, 'frame_' + String(fi).padStart(5, '0') + '.png'), fBuf);",
    "  }",
    "",
    "  const mp4Path = path.join(tmpDir, 'clip_' + idx + '.mp4');",
    "  execSync('ffmpeg -y -r 24 -i \"' + path.join(framesDir, 'frame_%05d.png') + '\" -c:v libx264 -preset fast -crf 18 -pix_fmt yuv420p \"' + mp4Path + '\"', { timeout: 60000 });",
    "",
    "  const dur = frames.length / 24;",
    "  return { clip: fs.readFileSync(mp4Path).toString('base64'), duration: dur };",
    "}",
    "",
    "async function main() {",
    "  const clips = [];",
    "  const durations = [];",
    "  for (let i = 0; i < images.length; i++) {",
    "    process.stderr.write('Clip ' + (i+1) + '/' + images.length + ' (' + Math.round(timeLeft()/1000) + 's left)\\n');",
    "    const result = await animateImage(images[i], motionPrompts[i], i);",
    "    clips.push(result.clip);",
    "    durations.push(result.duration);",
    "    process.stderr.write('  Done: ' + result.duration.toFixed(2) + 's\\n');",
    "  }",
    "  process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ clips, durations }));",
    "}",
    "main().catch(e => { process.stderr.write('FATAL: ' + e.message + '\\n'); process.exit(1); });"
  ];

  fs.writeFileSync(path.join(tmpDir, 'animate.js'), script.join('\n'));

  const output = await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    exec(
      `node "${path.join(tmpDir, 'animate.js')}" "${tmpDir}"`,
      { timeout: 9600000, maxBuffer: 500 * 1024 * 1024 },
      (error, stdout, stderr) => {
        if (error) {
          const fm = (stderr||'').match(/FATAL: ([\s\S]+)/);
          const tail = (stderr||'').split('\n').filter(l=>l.trim()).slice(-5).join(' | ');
          reject(new Error(fm ? fm[1].trim() : tail || error.message));
        } else {
          resolve(stdout);
        }
      }
    );
  });

  const result = JSON.parse(output);

  return {
    json: {
      videoClipBase64Array: result.clips,
      clipCount: result.clips.length,
      clipDurations: result.durations,
      script: imgData.script,
      title: imgData.title,
      description: imgData.description,
      tags: imgData.tags
    }
  };
} finally {
  try { fs.rmSync(tmpDir, { recursive: true, force: true }); } catch(e) {}
}
